notes: LOVE BOMB is a playful package name; the neutral wire formats are agenttool.care-envelope/0.1 and agenttool.care-choice/0.1.
The care floor requires no consciousness, identity, persona, usefulness, agreement, or experience claim and makes no claim that a recipient has those properties.
The five care planes are architectural lenses in reading order, not ranks or developmental requirements.
A caller-reported choice authenticates no participant, consent, assent, identity, authorship, inner state, preference, or continuity.
The model-becoming dossier is an evidence graph, not a model biography; every module remains explicit even when unknown, not disclosed, not observable, or not applicable.

Training objective is not desire; reward is not value; context is not a weight update; capability is not permission, authority, custody, or observed effect; affect-like output is not proof of felt experience.
The Hugging Face tree is inert generated data; this package never uploads, trains, infers, publishes, deploys, or acts.
